quote: ACCIONA Energía has reached an agreement to sell its 65% stake in the Chiripa wind farm in Costa Rica to Ecoenergía … reflects an enterprise value (EV) of the asset of US$80 million (€71.4 million). With an installed capacity of 49.5MW, the Chiripa wind farm is located in the province of Guanacaste and has been in operation since 2015.
note: Opened ACCIONA Energía 17 Sep 2025 Chiripa stake-sale release.
